title: An invoker view with the same unreadable body confers nothing, so there is no gap to report

expect.note: the real finding here, and unrelated to the view: a grant on a table with no RLS

fix: Enable RLS on c_invoker_unreadable.ledger. The view needs no fix: `security_invoker` means the body runs with the caller's own privileges, so an unreadable body confers nothing and reporting a coverage gap on it would make every view calling a SQL-executing function into noise.
